    band_width = int(extra.get('band_width', 5))
    max_pairs = int(extra.get('max_pairs', 128))

    # Compute ranks ascending (lower objective is better)
    ranks = objective.argsort(dim=1).argsort(dim=1)  # (B, N)

    # For each batch, select anchors as all items
    anchor_idx = torch.arange(N, device=device)  # (N,)

    # For each anchor, find candidate losers with rank in (rank_anchor+1) to (rank_anchor+band_width)
    # ranks shape (B,N)
    # Expand ranks to (B,N,1) and (B,1,N) for broadcasting
    rank_anchor = ranks.unsqueeze(2)  # (B,N,1)
    rank_candidates = ranks.unsqueeze(1)  # (B,1,N)

    # Create mask of candidates in band after anchor
    band_mask = (rank_candidates > rank_anchor) & (rank_candidates <= rank_anchor + band_width)

    # Also enforce objective(anchor) < objective(candidate) to ensure winner/loser
    obj_anchor = objective.unsqueeze(2)  # (B,N,1)
    obj_candidate = objective.unsqueeze(1)  # (B,1,N)
    winner_mask = obj_anchor < obj_candidate

    mask = band_mask & winner_mask  # (B, N, N)

    b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx = mask.nonzero(as_tuple=True)
    if b_idx.numel() == 0:
        return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx), weight=None, meta={'builder': 'anchor_vs_band_weighted_gap'})

    # Compute gap weights capped to [0,1]
    gap = (obj_candidate - obj_anchor)[b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx]
    gap_capped = gap.clamp(max=1.0)

    # Limit pairs to max_pairs by highest gap
    if b_idx.numel() > max_pairs:
        topk_vals, topk_idx = torch.topk(gap_capped, k=max_pairs, largest=True, sorted=False)
        b_idx = b_idx[topk_idx]
        winner_idx = winner_idx[topk_idx]
        loser_idx = loser_idx[topk_idx]
        gap_capped = gap_capped[topk_idx]

    return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx), weight=gap_capped, meta={'builder': 'anchor_vs_band_weighted_gap', 'band_width': band_width, 'max_pairs': max_pairs})

    exp_cap = float(extra.get('exp_cap', 10.0))

    B, N = objective.shape
    # Compute ranks per batch (argsort twice)
    ranks = objective.argsort(dim=1).argsort(dim=1)  # shape (B, N)

    # For each item, find candidates within rank band [rank - band_width, rank + band_width]
    # We'll create pairs (winner, loser) where winner objective < loser objective (lower is better)

    # Expand ranks for pairwise comparison
    ranks_exp_w = ranks.unsqueeze(2)  # (B, N, 1)
    ranks_exp_l = ranks.unsqueeze(1)  # (B, 1, N)

    # Rank difference mask: within band_width and not self-pair
    rank_diff = ranks_exp_l - ranks_exp_w  # (B, N, N)
    band_mask = (rank_diff > 0) & (rank_diff <= band_width)  # only pairs where loser rank is within band above winner rank

    # Disagreement: objective difference sign mismatches log_prob ordering
    # Compute objective difference and log_prob difference
    obj_diff = objective.unsqueeze(2) - objective.unsqueeze(1)  # (B, N, N)
    log_prob = feature_cache.get('log_prob', None)
    if log_prob is None:
        # fallback: no weighting

    b_idx = b_idx_anchors[b_idx_pairs]

    gaps = rank_diff[b_idx_pairs, loser_idx].float()

    weights = (band_width + 1 - gaps) / band_width
    weights = weights.clamp(min=0, max=1)

g_ir.name: pairwise_advantage_builder_fixed
g_ir.intuition: Constructs pairwise preferences by comparing all distinct pairs within each batch instance, assigning the lower objective value index as winner and the higher as loser. Computes advantage_gap as loser_obj - winner_obj ensuring nonnegative weights. Uses vectorized indexing without loops and returns PrefBatch with pair_idx tuple (b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx) and nonnegative weight equal to advantage_gap, satisfying PrefBatch requirements and semantics.
g_ir.code:
def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache["objective"]  # (B,K)
    log_prob = feature_cache["log_prob"]  # (B,K)
    B, K = objective.shape
    device = objective.device

    idxs = torch.arange(K, device=device)
    winner_idx = idxs.repeat_interleave(K)  # (K*K,)
    loser_idx = idxs.repeat(K)              # (K*K,)
    mask = winner_idx != loser_idx          # exclude self-pairs
    winner_idx = winner_idx[mask]            # (num_pairs,)
    loser_idx = loser_idx[mask]              # (num_pairs,)

    num_pairs = winner_idx.size(0)
    b_idx = torch.arange(B, device=device).repeat_interleave(num_pairs)  # (B*num_pairs,)

    winner_idx = winner_idx.repeat(B)  # (B*num_pairs,)
    loser_idx = loser_idx.repeat(B)    # (B*num_pairs,)

    obj_w_raw = objective[b_idx, winner_idx]
    obj_l_raw = objective[b_idx, loser_idx]

    # Determine true winner and loser per pair by objective (lower is better)
    winner_mask = obj_w_raw <= obj_l_raw
    true_winner_idx = torch.where(winner_mask, winner_idx, loser_idx)
    true_loser_idx = torch.where(winner_mask, loser_idx, winner_idx)

    obj_w = objective[b_idx, true_winner_idx]
    obj_l = objective[b_idx, true_loser_idx]

    advantage_gap = (obj_l - obj_w).clamp(min=0)

    pair_idx = (b_idx, true_winner_idx, true_loser_idx)

    return PrefBatch(mode="pairwise", pair_idx=pair_idx, weight=advantage_gap, meta={})

def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']  # shape (B, N)
    batch_size, n = objective.shape

    # Compute ranks per batch by sorting objectives ascending (lower is better)
    sorted_obj, sorted_idx = objective.sort(dim=1)  # ascending
    ranks = torch.zeros_like(sorted_idx)
    ranks.scatter_(1, sorted_idx, torch.arange(n, device=objective.device).view(1, -1).expand(batch_size, n))

    band_width = int(extra.get('rank_band_width', 3))
    max_pairs = int(extra.get('max_pairs', 128))

    # For each item, find candidates within rank band
    # We create pairwise rank differences: shape (B, N, N)
    ranks_i = ranks.unsqueeze(2)  # (B, N, 1)
    ranks_j = ranks.unsqueeze(1)  # (B, 1, N)
    rank_diff = torch.abs(ranks_i - ranks_j)  # (B, N, N)

    # Mask pairs within band width and where i != j
    band_mask = (rank_diff <= band_width) & (ranks_i != ranks_j)

    # Further mask winners with strictly better (lower) objective
    obj_i = objective.unsqueeze(2)  # (B, N, 1)
    obj_j = objective.unsqueeze(1)  # (B, 1, N)
    winner_mask = obj_i < obj_j

    mask = band_mask & winner_mask

    b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx = mask.nonzero(as_tuple=True)

    # Compute gap weights capped to [0, 1]
    gap = (obj_j - obj_i)[b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx]
    gap_capped = gap.clamp(max=1.0)

    weight = gap_capped

    # Limit number of pairs by highest gap weights
    if b_idx.numel() > max_pairs:
        topk_vals, topk_idx = torch.topk(weight, k=max_pairs, largest=True, sorted=False)
        b_idx = b_idx[topk_idx]
        winner_idx = winner_idx[topk_idx]
        loser_idx = loser_idx[topk_idx]
        weight = weight[topk_idx]

    return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx), weight=weight, meta={'builder': 'rank_band_sparse', 'band_width': band_width, 'max_pairs': max_pairs})

def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']  # (B, N)
    log_prob = feature_cache['log_prob']  # (B, N)
    B, N = objective.shape
    device = objective.device

    band_width = int(extra.get('band_width', 5))
    max_pairs = int(extra.get('max_pairs', 128))
    tie_zone = float(extra.get('tie_zone', 0.1))

    # Compute ranks ascending (lower is better)
    ranks = objective.argsort(dim=1).argsort(dim=1)  # (B, N)

    # Anchor mask: items with rank divisible by band_width to sparsify anchors
    anchor_mask = (ranks % band_width) == 0  # (B, N) bool
    b_idx_anchors, anchor_idx = anchor_mask.nonzero(as_tuple=True)
    if anchor_idx.numel() == 0:
        return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(b_idx_anchors, anchor_idx, anchor_idx), weight=None, meta={'builder': 'builder_sparse_anchor_disagreement_rankgap_tiezone'})

    anchor_ranks = ranks[b_idx_anchors, anchor_idx]  # (num_anchors,)
    anchor_obj = objective[b_idx_anchors, anchor_idx]  # (num_anchors,)
    anchor_logp = log_prob[b_idx_anchors, anchor_idx]  # (num_anchors,)

    # Candidate ranks and objectives for each anchor
    candidate_ranks = ranks[b_idx_anchors]  # (num_anchors, N)
    candidate_obj = objective[b_idx_anchors]  # (num_anchors, N)
    candidate_logp = log_prob[b_idx_anchors]  # (num_anchors, N)

    # Rank difference: candidate rank - anchor rank
    rank_diff = candidate_ranks - anchor_ranks.unsqueeze(1)  # (num_anchors, N)

    # Select candidates within band (1 to band_width)
    band_mask = (rank_diff > 0) & (rank_diff <= band_width)

    # Disagreement: sign mismatch between objective difference and log_prob difference
    obj_diff = candidate_obj - anchor_obj.unsqueeze(1)  # (num_anchors, N)
    logp_diff = candidate_logp - anchor_logp.unsqueeze(1)  # (num_anchors, N)
    sign_obj = obj_diff > 0
    sign_lp = logp_diff > 0
    disagreement_mask = sign_obj != sign_lp

    # Tie-zone constraint: exclude pairs with rank gap less than tie_zone
    tie_zone_mask = (rank_diff.float() >= tie_zone)

    # Final mask combining band, disagreement, and tie-zone
    mask = band_mask & disagreement_mask & tie_zone_mask

    b_idx_pairs, loser_idx = mask.nonzero(as_tuple=True)
    winner_idx = anchor_idx[b_idx_pairs]
    b_idx = b_idx_anchors[b_idx_pairs]

    # Compute weights inversely proportional to normalized rank gap
    gaps = rank_diff[b_idx_pairs, loser_idx].float()
    weights = (band_width + 1 - gaps) / band_width  # in (0,1]
    weights = weights.clamp(min=0)

    # Limit pairs to max_pairs by top weights
    if weights.numel() > max_pairs:
        topk_vals, topk_idx = torch.topk(weights, max_pairs, sorted=False)
        b_idx = b_idx[topk_idx]
        winner_idx = winner_idx[topk_idx]
        loser_idx = loser_idx[topk_idx]
        weights = topk_vals

    return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx), weight=weights, meta={'builder': 'builder_sparse_anchor_disagreement_rankgap_tiezone', 'band_width': band_width, 'max_pairs': max_pairs, 'tie_zone': tie_zone})

def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']  # shape (B, N)
    log_prob = feature_cache['log_prob']  # shape (B, N)
    gap_threshold = float(extra.get('gap_threshold', 0.2))
    max_pairs = int(extra.get('max_pairs', 256))
    B, N = objective.shape

    # Generate all pairs excluding self-pairs
    idxs = torch.arange(N, device=objective.device)
    winner_idx = idxs.repeat_interleave(N)  # (N*N,)
    loser_idx = idxs.repeat(N)             # (N*N,)
    mask = winner_idx != loser_idx
    winner_idx = winner_idx[mask]
    loser_idx = loser_idx[mask]

    loser_idx = loser_idx.repeat(B)

    obj_l = objective[b_idx, loser_idx]
    advantage_gap = (obj_l - obj_w).clamp(min=0)

    gap_mask = advantage_gap > gap_threshold
    b_idx = b_idx[gap_mask]
    winner_idx = winner_idx[gap_mask]
    loser_idx = loser_idx[gap_mask]
    advantage_gap = advantage_gap[gap_mask]

        loser_idx = loser_idx[topk_idx]

def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']  # (B, N)
    log_prob = feature_cache['log_prob']  # (B, N)
    B, N = objective.shape
    device = objective.device

    band_width = int(extra.get('band_width', 6))
    max_pairs = int(extra.get('max_pairs', 128))
    anchor_step = int(extra.get('anchor_step', 4))

    ranks = objective.argsort(dim=1).argsort(dim=1)  # (B, N)

    # Select anchors at ranks divisible by anchor_step (sparse anchors)
    anchor_mask = (ranks % anchor_step) == 0
    b_idx_anchors, anchor_idx = anchor_mask.nonzero(as_tuple=True)
    if anchor_idx.numel() == 0:
        empty = torch.tensor([], device=device, dtype=torch.long)
        return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(empty, empty, empty), weight=None, meta={'builder': 'rankband_anchor_disagreement_weighted'})

    anchor_ranks = ranks[b_idx_anchors, anchor_idx]  # (num_anchors,)
    anchor_obj = objective[b_idx_anchors, anchor_idx]  # (num_anchors,)
    anchor_logp = log_prob[b_idx_anchors, anchor_idx]  # (num_anchors,)

    # Candidates: all items in the same batches
    candidate_ranks = ranks[b_idx_anchors]  # (num_anchors, N)
    candidate_obj = objective[b_idx_anchors]  # (num_anchors, N)
    candidate_logp = log_prob[b_idx_anchors]  # (num_anchors, N)

    rank_diff = candidate_ranks - anchor_ranks.unsqueeze(1)  # (num_anchors, N)

    # Band mask: candidates within (0, band_width] rank gap above anchor
    band_mask = (rank_diff > 0) & (rank_diff <= band_width)

    # Disagreement mask: objective and log_prob order differ
    obj_diff = candidate_obj - anchor_obj.unsqueeze(1)  # (num_anchors, N)
    logp_diff = candidate_logp - anchor_logp.unsqueeze(1)  # (num_anchors, N)
    sign_obj = obj_diff > 0
    sign_lp = logp_diff > 0
    disagreement_mask = sign_obj != sign_lp

    mask = band_mask & disagreement_mask

    b_idx_pairs, loser_idx = mask.nonzero(as_tuple=True)
    winner_idx = anchor_idx[b_idx_pairs]
    b_idx = b_idx_anchors[b_idx_pairs]

    # Compute advantage gap
    advantage_gap = torch.abs(objective[b_idx, winner_idx] - objective[b_idx, loser_idx])

    # Normalize by rank difference to weight pairs stronger if rank gap is smaller
    rank_gaps = rank_diff[b_idx_pairs, loser_idx].float().clamp(min=1.0)
    weights = (advantage_gap / rank_gaps).clamp(min=0)

    # Cap pairs by top-k weights
    if weights.numel() > max_pairs:
        topk_vals, topk_idx = torch.topk(weights, max_pairs, sorted=False)
        b_idx = b_idx[topk_idx]
        winner_idx = winner_idx[topk_idx]
        loser_idx = loser_idx[topk_idx]
        weights = topk_vals

    pair_idx = (b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx)
    return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=pair_idx, weight=weights, meta={'builder': 'rankband_anchor_disagreement_weighted', 'band_width': band_width, 'anchor_step': anchor_step, 'max_pairs': max_pairs})

def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache["objective"]  # (B,K)
    log_prob = feature_cache["log_prob"]  # (B,K)
    B, K = objective.shape
    device = objective.device

    idxs = torch.arange(K, device=device)
    winner_idx = idxs.repeat_interleave(K)  # (K*K,)
    loser_idx = idxs.repeat(K)              # (K*K,)
    mask = winner_idx != loser_idx          # exclude self-pairs
    winner_idx = winner_idx[mask]            # (num_pairs,)
    loser_idx = loser_idx[mask]              # (num_pairs,)

    num_pairs = winner_idx.size(0)
    b_idx = torch.arange(B, device=device).repeat_interleave(num_pairs)  # (B*num_pairs,)

    winner_idx = winner_idx.repeat(B)  # (B*num_pairs,)
    loser_idx = loser_idx.repeat(B)    # (B*num_pairs,)

    obj_w = objective[b_idx, winner_idx]
    obj_l = objective[b_idx, loser_idx]

    winner_mask = obj_w <= obj_l
    true_winner_idx = torch.where(winner_mask, winner_idx, loser_idx)
    true_loser_idx = torch.where(winner_mask, loser_idx, winner_idx)

    advantage_gap = (objective[b_idx, true_loser_idx] - objective[b_idx, true_winner_idx])
    advantage_gap = advantage_gap.clamp(max=1.0)

    pair_idx = (b_idx, true_winner_idx, true_loser_idx)

    return PrefBatch(mode="pairwise", pair_idx=pair_idx, weight=advantage_gap, meta={})

g_ir.name: robust_pairwise_preference_builder
g_ir.intuition: Combines the comprehensive pairwise comparison approach of the fixed advantage builder with the selective filtering and weighting strategies from the disagreement-based methods, ensuring stable, meaningful, and balanced preference pairs while maintaining simplicity and robustness. Incorporates explicit pairwise comparison, non-negativity, and normalization to improve stability and diversity of preferences.

def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']  # (B, N)
    log_prob = feature_cache['log_prob']  # (B, N)
    B, N = objective.shape
    device = objective.device

    # Select top-level anchor indices based on rank and disagreement
    ranks = objective.argsort(dim=1).argsort(dim=1)  # (B, N)
    anchor_mask = (ranks % 10 == 0)  # periodic anchors for diversity
    b_idx_anchors, anchor_idx = anchor_mask.nonzero(as_tuple=True)
    if anchor_idx.numel() == 0:
        return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(b_idx_anchors, torch.tensor([], device=device, dtype=torch.long), torch.tensor([], device=device, dtype=torch.long)), weight=None, meta={'builder': 'robust_pairwise_preference_builder'})

    anchor_ranks = ranks[b_idx_anchors, anchor_idx]
    anchor_obj = objective[b_idx_anchors, anchor_idx]
    anchor_logp = log_prob[b_idx_anchors, anchor_idx]

    candidate_ranks = ranks[b_idx_anchors]
    candidate_obj = objective[b_idx_anchors]
    candidate_logp = log_prob[b_idx_anchors]

    rank_diff = candidate_ranks - anchor_ranks.unsqueeze(1)

    # Filter candidates with rank gap and disagreement in order
    band_mask = (rank_diff >= 5) & (rank_diff <= 15)
    obj_diff = candidate_obj - anchor_obj.unsqueeze(1)
    logp_diff = candidate_logp - anchor_logp.unsqueeze(1)
    sign_obj = obj_diff > 0
    sign_lp = logp_diff > 0
    disagreement_mask = sign_obj != sign_lp
    mask = band_mask & disagreement_mask

    b_idx_pairs, loser_idx = mask.nonzero(as_tuple=True)
    winner_idx = anchor_idx[b_idx_pairs]
    b_idx = b_idx_anchors[b_idx_pairs]

    # Compute normalized advantage gap as weight
    adv_gap = torch.abs(objective[b_idx, winner_idx] - objective[b_idx, loser_idx])
    max_gap = adv_gap.max().clamp(min=1e-6)
    weights = adv_gap / max_gap
    weights = weights.clamp(0, 1)

    # Cap number of pairs to ensure robustness
    if weights.numel() > 128:
        topk_vals, topk_idx = weights.topk(128, sorted=False)
        b_idx = b_idx[topk_idx]
        winner_idx = winner_idx[topk_idx]
        loser_idx = loser_idx[topk_idx]
        weights = topk_vals

    pair_idx = (b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx)
    return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=pair_idx, weight=weights, meta={'builder': 'robust_pairwise_preference_builder', 'max_pairs': 128})

def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    # Retrieve core tensors
    objective = feature_cache['objective']  # (B, N)
    log_prob = feature_cache['log_prob']  # (B, N)
    B, N = objective.shape
    device = objective.device

    # Configurable parameters with defaults
    band_width = int(extra.get('band_width', 7))  # Slightly increased from 5 to 7
    max_pairs = int(extra.get('max_pairs', 256))  # Increased from 128 to 256
    tiezone_eps = float(extra.get('tiezone_eps', 0.005))  # Tighter threshold for gap filtering

    # Compute ranks (ascending: lower is better)
    ranks = objective.argsort(dim=1).argsort(dim=1)  # (B, N)

    # Identify anchor items based on rank divisibility
    anchor_mask = (ranks % band_width) == 0  # (B, N) bool
    b_idx_anchors, anchor_idx = anchor_mask.nonzero(as_tuple=True)
    if anchor_idx.numel() == 0:
        return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(b_idx_anchors, anchor_idx, anchor_idx), weight=None, meta={'builder': 'pairwise_tiezone_filtered_rankgap_v2'})

    # Gather anchor-specific data
    anchor_ranks = ranks[b_idx_anchors, anchor_idx]  # (num_anchors,)
    anchor_obj = objective[b_idx_anchors, anchor_idx]  # (num_anchors,)
    anchor_logp = log_prob[b_idx_anchors, anchor_idx]  # (num_anchors,)

    # Expand for candidate comparison
    candidate_ranks = ranks[b_idx_anchors]  # (num_anchors, N)
    candidate_obj = objective[b_idx_anchors]  # (num_anchors, N)
    candidate_logp = log_prob[b_idx_anchors]  # (num_anchors, N)

    # Calculate rank differences
    rank_diff = candidate_ranks - anchor_ranks.unsqueeze(1)  # (num_anchors, N)

    # Mask for candidates within the band
    band_mask = (rank_diff > 0) & (rank_diff <= band_width)

    # Determine pairwise disagreement based on sign mismatch
    obj_diff = candidate_obj - anchor_obj.unsqueeze(1)  # (num_anchors, N)
    logp_diff = candidate_logp - anchor_logp.unsqueeze(1)  # (num_anchors, N)
    sign_obj = obj_diff > 0
    sign_lp = logp_diff > 0
    disagreement_mask = sign_obj != sign_lp

    # Apply tie-zone filtering with tighter epsilon
    advantage_gap = obj_diff.abs()
    tiezone_mask = advantage_gap.ge(tiezone_eps)  # True if gap >= epsilon

    # Combine masks to identify valid pairs
    mask = band_mask & disagreement_mask & tiezone_mask

    # Get indices of valid pairs
    b_idx_pairs, loser_idx = mask.nonzero(as_tuple=True)
    winner_idx = anchor_idx[b_idx_pairs]
    b_idx = b_idx_anchors[b_idx_pairs]

    # Calculate normalized rank gaps for weighting
    gaps = rank_diff[b_idx_pairs, loser_idx].float()
    weights = (band_width + 2 - gaps) / (band_width + 1)  # Slightly smoother weight scale
    weights = weights.clamp(min=0)

    # Cap to max_pairs with top weights
    if weights.numel() > max_pairs:
        topk_vals, topk_idx = weights.topk(max_pairs, sorted=False)
        b_idx = b_idx[topk_idx]
        winner_idx = winner_idx[topk_idx]
        loser_idx = loser_idx[topk_idx]
        weights = topk_vals

    return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx), weight=weights, meta={'builder': 'pairwise_tiezone_filtered_rankgap_v2', 'band_width': band_width, 'max_pairs': max_pairs, 'tiezone_eps': tiezone_eps})

def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']  # (B, N)
    log_prob = feature_cache['log_prob']  # (B, N)
    B, N = objective.shape
    device = objective.device

    band_width = int(extra.get('band_width', 5))
    max_pairs = int(extra.get('max_pairs', 128))
    tiezone_eps = float(extra.get('tiezone_eps', 0.01))

    # Compute ranks ascending (lower is better)
    ranks = objective.argsort(dim=1).argsort(dim=1)  # (B, N)

    # Anchor mask: items with rank divisible by band_width to sparsify anchors
    anchor_mask = (ranks % band_width) == 0  # (B, N) bool
    b_idx_anchors, anchor_idx = anchor_mask.nonzero(as_tuple=True)
    if anchor_idx.numel() == 0:
        return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(b_idx_anchors, anchor_idx, anchor_idx), weight=None, meta={'builder': 'pairwise_tiezone_filtered_rankgap'})

    anchor_ranks = ranks[b_idx_anchors, anchor_idx]  # (num_anchors,)
    anchor_obj = objective[b_idx_anchors, anchor_idx]  # (num_anchors,)
    anchor_logp = log_prob[b_idx_anchors, anchor_idx]  # (num_anchors,)

    # Candidate ranks and objectives for each anchor
    candidate_ranks = ranks[b_idx_anchors]  # (num_anchors, N)
    candidate_obj = objective[b_idx_anchors]  # (num_anchors, N)
    candidate_logp = log_prob[b_idx_anchors]  # (num_anchors, N)

    # Rank difference: candidate rank - anchor rank
    rank_diff = candidate_ranks - anchor_ranks.unsqueeze(1)  # (num_anchors, N)

    # Select candidates within band (1 to band_width)
    band_mask = (rank_diff > 0) & (rank_diff <= band_width)

    # Disagreement: sign mismatch between objective difference and log_prob difference
    obj_diff = candidate_obj - anchor_obj.unsqueeze(1)  # (num_anchors, N)
    logp_diff = candidate_logp - anchor_logp.unsqueeze(1)  # (num_anchors, N)
    sign_obj = obj_diff > 0
    sign_lp = logp_diff > 0
    disagreement_mask = sign_obj != sign_lp

    # Tie-zone filtering: exclude pairs with small absolute advantage gap
    advantage_gap = obj_diff.abs()
    tiezone_mask = advantage_gap.ge(tiezone_eps)  # True if gap >= eps

    # Final mask combining band, disagreement, and tie-zone
    mask = band_mask & disagreement_mask & tiezone_mask

    winner_idx = anchor_idx[b_idx_pairs]
    b_idx = b_idx_anchors[b_idx_pairs]

    gaps = rank_diff[b_idx_pairs, loser_idx].float()

        winner_idx = winner_idx[topk_idx]

def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):

    # Compute ranks ascending (lower is better)
    ranks = objective.argsort(dim=1).argsort(dim=1)  # (B, N)

    # Anchor indices: items with rank less than band_width
    anchor_mask = ranks < band_width  # (B, N) bool

    # Find indices of anchors per batch
    b_idx_anchors, anchor_idx = anchor_mask.nonzero(as_tuple=True)  # variable length

    if anchor_idx.numel() == 0:
        # No anchors, return empty
        return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(torch.tensor([], device=device), torch.tensor([], device=device), torch.tensor([], device=device)), weight=None, meta={'builder': 'anchor_vs_band_gap_expweight'})

    # Expand anchor ranks and objective
    anchor_ranks = ranks[b_idx_anchors, anchor_idx]  # (num_anchors,)
    anchor_obj = objective[b_idx_anchors, anchor_idx]  # (num_anchors,)

    # For each anchor, define band candidates with ranks in [anchor_rank +1, anchor_rank + band_width]
    # We create all pairs (anchor, candidate) by broadcasting

    # Prepare candidate ranks and indices
    candidate_ranks = ranks[b_idx_anchors]  # (num_anchors, N)
    candidate_obj = objective[b_idx_anchors]  # (num_anchors, N)

    b_idx = b_idx_anchors[b_idx_pairs]

def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache["objective"]  # (B,K)
    B, K = objective.shape
    device = objective.device
    topk = int(extra.get("topk", 512))

    idxs = torch.arange(K, device=device)
    winner_idx = idxs.repeat_interleave(K)  # (K*K,)
    loser_idx = idxs.repeat(K)              # (K*K,)
    mask = winner_idx != loser_idx          # exclude self-pairs
    winner_idx = winner_idx[mask]            # (num_pairs,)
    loser_idx = loser_idx[mask]              # (num_pairs,)
    num_pairs = winner_idx.size(0)

    b_idx = torch.arange(B, device=device).repeat_interleave(num_pairs)  # (B*num_pairs,)
    winner_idx = winner_idx.repeat(B)  # (B*num_pairs,)
    loser_idx = loser_idx.repeat(B)    # (B*num_pairs,)

    obj_w = objective[b_idx, winner_idx]
    obj_l = objective[b_idx, loser_idx]

    # Determine true winner and loser per pair by objective (lower is better)
    winner_mask = obj_w <= obj_l
    true_winner_idx = torch.where(winner_mask, winner_idx, loser_idx)
    true_loser_idx = torch.where(winner_mask, loser_idx, winner_idx)

    obj_w = objective[b_idx, true_winner_idx]
    obj_l = objective[b_idx, true_loser_idx]

    advantage_gap = (obj_l - obj_w).clamp(min=0)

    # Group pairs by batch index
    # To apply topk filtering per batch, reshape advantage_gap and indices
    advantage_gap_reshaped = advantage_gap.view(B, -1)  # (B, num_pairs)
    true_winner_idx_reshaped = true_winner_idx.view(B, -1)
    true_loser_idx_reshaped = true_loser_idx.view(B, -1)

    k = min(topk, advantage_gap_reshaped.size(1))
    topk_vals, topk_idx = advantage_gap_reshaped.topk(k, dim=1)

    batch_indices = torch.arange(B, device=device).unsqueeze(1).expand(-1, k)
    topk_winner = true_winner_idx_reshaped[batch_indices, topk_idx]
    topk_loser = true_loser_idx_reshaped[batch_indices, topk_idx]

    pair_idx = (batch_indices.reshape(-1), topk_winner.reshape(-1), topk_loser.reshape(-1))
    weight = topk_vals.reshape(-1)

    return PrefBatch(mode="pairwise", pair_idx=pair_idx, weight=weight, meta={"builder": "pairwise_advantage_builder_topk_filter"})

def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']  # shape (B, N)
    batch_size, n = objective.shape

    # Compute ranks per batch by sorting objectives ascending (lower is better)
    sorted_obj, sorted_idx = objective.sort(dim=1)  # ascending
    ranks = torch.zeros_like(sorted_idx)
    ranks.scatter_(1, sorted_idx, torch.arange(n, device=objective.device).view(1, -1).expand(batch_size, n))

    band_width = int(extra.get('rank_band_width', 3))
    max_pairs = int(extra.get('max_pairs', 128))

    # For each item, find candidates within rank band
    # We create pairwise rank differences: shape (B, N, N)
    ranks_i = ranks.unsqueeze(2)  # (B, N, 1)
    ranks_j = ranks.unsqueeze(1)  # (B, 1, N)
    rank_diff = torch.abs(ranks_i - ranks_j)  # (B, N, N)

    # Mask pairs within band width and where i != j
    band_mask = (rank_diff <= band_width) & (ranks_i != ranks_j)

    # Further mask winners with strictly better (lower) objective
    obj_i = objective.unsqueeze(2)  # (B, N, 1)
    obj_j = objective.unsqueeze(1)  # (B, 1, N)
    winner_mask = obj_i < obj_j

    mask = band_mask & winner_mask

    b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx = mask.nonzero(as_tuple=True)

    # Compute gap weights capped to [0, 1]
    gap = (obj_j - obj_i)[b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx]
    gap_capped = gap.clamp(max=1.0)

    weight = gap_capped

    # Limit number of pairs by highest gap weights
    if b_idx.numel() > max_pairs:
        topk_vals, topk_idx = torch.topk(weight, k=max_pairs, largest=True, sorted=False)
        b_idx = b_idx[topk_idx]
        winner_idx = winner_idx[topk_idx]
        loser_idx = loser_idx[topk_idx]
        weight = weight[topk_idx]

    return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx), weight=weight, meta={'builder': 'rank_band_sparse', 'band_width': band_width, 'max_pairs': max_pairs})

    candidate_obj = objective[b_idx_anchors]  # (num_anchors, N)
    candidate_logp = log_prob[b_idx_anchors]  # (num_anchors, N)

g_ir.intuition: Constructs pairwise preferences by comparing all distinct pairs within each batch instance, assigning the lower objective value index as winner and the higher as loser. Computes advantage_gap as loser_obj - winner_obj ensuring nonnegative weights. def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache["objective"]  # (B,K)
    log_prob = feature_cache["log_prob"]  # (B,K)
    B, K = objective.shape
    device = objective.device

    # Generate all pair indices
    idxs = torch.arange(K, device=device)
    winner_idx = idxs.unsqueeze(1).repeat(1, K).view(-1)  # (K*K,)
    loser_idx = idxs.unsqueeze(0).repeat(K, 1).view(-1)   # (K*K,)

    # Exclude self-pairs
    mask = winner_idx != loser_idx
    winner_idx = winner_idx[mask]
    loser_idx = loser_idx[mask]

    num_pairs = winner_idx.size(0)
    b_idx = torch.arange(B, device=device).unsqueeze(1).repeat(1, num_pairs).view(-1)  # (B*num_pairs,)
    winner_idx = winner_idx.repeat(B)
    loser_idx = loser_idx.repeat(B)

    # Gather objective values
    obj_w = objective[b_idx, winner_idx]
    obj_l = objective[b_idx, loser_idx]

    # Determine true winner and loser based on objective (lower is better)
    winner_mask = obj_w <= obj_l
    true_winner_idx = torch.where(winner_mask, winner_idx, loser_idx)
    true_loser_idx = torch.where(winner_mask, loser_idx, winner_idx)

    # Compute advantage gap
    adv_gap = (objective[b_idx, true_loser_idx] - objective[b_idx, true_winner_idx]).clamp(min=0)

    pair_idx = (b_idx, true_winner_idx, true_loser_idx)
    return PrefBatch(mode="pairwise", pair_idx=pair_idx, weight=adv_gap, meta={})

def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):

    rank_i = ranks.unsqueeze(2)  # (B, N, 1)

    rank_diff = rank_j - rank_i  # (B, N, N)

    rank_gaps = rank_diff[b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx].float()
    weights = (max_band + 1 - rank_gaps) / max_band  # larger gap lower weight

    ranks = objective.argsort(dim=1).argsort(dim=1)

    b_idx_anchors, anchor_idx = anchor_mask.nonzero(as_tuple=True)
    if anchor_idx.numel() == 0:
        return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(b_idx_anchors, anchor_idx, anchor_idx), weight=None, meta={'builder': 'robust_simplified'})

    anchor_ranks = ranks[b_idx_anchors, anchor_idx]
    anchor_obj = objective[b_idx_anchors, anchor_idx]
    anchor_logp = log_prob[b_idx_anchors, anchor_idx]

    candidate_ranks = ranks[b_idx_anchors]
    candidate_obj = objective[b_idx_anchors]
    candidate_logp = log_prob[b_idx_anchors]

    # Calculate rank difference
    rank_diff = candidate_ranks - anchor_ranks.unsqueeze(1)

    winner_idx = anchor_idx[b_idx_pairs]
    b_idx = b_idx_anchors[b_idx_pairs]

    # Compute weights based on normalized rank gap
    gaps = rank_diff[b_idx_pairs, loser_idx].float()

g_ir.intuition: Constructs pairwise preferences by comparing all distinct pairs within each batch instance, determining the true winner and loser based on objective, and computing advantage gaps as the non-negative difference. Uses vectorized tensor operations to generate all pairs without explicit loops, ensuring efficiency and compliance with the pairwise mode. Returns PrefBatch with pair indices (batch, winner, loser) and advantages as weights, capturing preference strength while avoiding self-pairs and ensuring non-negativity.
g_ir.code:
def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache["objective"]  # (B,K)
    log_prob = feature_cache["log_prob"]  # (B,K)
    B, K = objective.shape
    device = objective.device

    idxs = torch.arange(K, device=device)
    # Generate all pair combinations
    winner_idx = idxs.unsqueeze(1).repeat(1, K).view(-1)  # (K*K,)
    loser_idx = idxs.repeat(K)  # (K*K,)
    # Create mask to exclude self-pairs
    mask = winner_idx != loser_idx  # (K*K,)
    winner_idx = winner_idx[mask]
    loser_idx = loser_idx[mask]

    num_pairs = winner_idx.size(0)
    b_idx = torch.arange(B, device=device).unsqueeze(1).repeat(1, num_pairs).view(-1)  # (B*num_pairs,)
    winner_idx_b = winner_idx.repeat(B)  # (B*num_pairs,)
    loser_idx_b = loser_idx.repeat(B)  # (B*num_pairs,)

    # Gather objective values
    obj_w = objective[b_idx, winner_idx_b]
    obj_l = objective[b_idx, loser_idx_b]

    # Determine true winner and loser based on objective (lower is better)
    winner_mask = obj_w <= obj_l
    true_winner_idx = torch.where(winner_mask, winner_idx_b, loser_idx_b)
    true_loser_idx = torch.where(winner_mask, loser_idx_b, winner_idx_b)

    # Compute advantage gap (non-negative)
    adv_gap = (objective[b_idx, true_loser_idx] - objective[b_idx, true_winner_idx]).clamp_min(0)

    pair_idx = (b_idx, true_winner_idx, true_loser_idx)
    return PrefBatch(mode="pairwise", pair_idx=pair_idx, weight=adv_gap, meta={})

g_ir.intuition: This builder combines the stability of clamp-based pairwise comparisons with the selective sparseness and disagreement filtering from advanced rank-gap and tiezone techniques, aiming for a simple yet robust preference selection that balances strictness and flexibility.
g_ir.code:
def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']  # (B, N)
    log_prob = feature_cache['log_prob']  # (B, N)
    B, N = objective.shape
    device = objective.device

    # Parameters for filtering
    band_width = int(extra.get('band_width', 5))
    max_pairs = int(extra.get('max_pairs', 128))
    tiezone_eps = float(extra.get('tiezone_eps', 0.01))

    # Compute ranks ascending (lower is better)
    ranks = objective.argsort(dim=1).argsort(dim=1)

    # Select sparse anchors at regular intervals
    anchor_mask = (ranks % band_width) == 0
    b_idx_anchors, anchor_idx = anchor_mask.nonzero(as_tuple=True)
    if anchor_idx.numel() == 0:
        return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(torch.tensor([], device=device), torch.tensor([], device=device), torch.tensor([], device=device)), weight=None, meta={'builder': 'robust_combined'})

    anchor_ranks = ranks[b_idx_anchors, anchor_idx]
    anchor_obj = objective[b_idx_anchors, anchor_idx]
    anchor_logp = log_prob[b_idx_anchors, anchor_idx]

    # Expand for candidate pairs
    candidate_ranks = ranks[b_idx_anchors]
    candidate_obj = objective[b_idx_anchors]
    candidate_logp = log_prob[b_idx_anchors]

    # Compute rank difference
    rank_diff = candidate_ranks - anchor_ranks.unsqueeze(1)

    # Filter candidates within band
    band_mask = (rank_diff > 0) & (rank_diff <= band_width)
    # Disagreement: different order between objective and log_prob
    obj_diff = candidate_obj - anchor_obj.unsqueeze(1)
    logp_diff = candidate_logp - anchor_logp.unsqueeze(1)
    sign_obj = obj_diff > 0
    sign_lp = logp_diff > 0
    disagreement_mask = sign_obj != sign_lp
    # Tie-zone exclusion for small advantage gaps
    tiezone_mask = (abs(obj_diff) >= float(extra.get('tiezone_eps', 0.01)))
    # Final mask combines all filters
    combined_mask = band_mask & disagreement_mask & tiezone_mask

    b_idx_pairs, loser_idx = combined_mask.nonzero(as_tuple=True)
    winner_idx = anchor_idx[b_idx_pairs]
    b_idx = b_idx_anchors[b_idx_pairs]

    # Compute adaptive weights based on normalized rank gap
    gaps = rank_diff[b_idx_pairs, loser_idx].float()
    weights = (band_width + 1 - gaps) / band_width
    weights = weights.clamp(min=0)

    # Limit number of pairs
    if weights.numel() > max_pairs:
        topk_vals, topk_idx = torch.topk(weights, max_pairs, sorted=False)
        b_idx = b_idx[topk_idx]
        winner_idx = winner_idx[topk_idx]
        loser_idx = loser_idx[topk_idx]
        weights = topk_vals

    return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx), weight=weights, meta={'builder': 'robust_combined', 'band_width': band_width, 'tiezone_eps': tiezone_eps, 'max_pairs': max_pairs})

    anchor_mask = (ranks % (band_width + 1)) == 0  # (B, N) bool
    b_idx_anchors, anchor_idx = anchor_mask.nonzero(as_tuple=True)
    if anchor_idx.numel() == 0:
        return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(b_idx_anchors, anchor_idx, anchor_idx), weight=None, meta={'builder': 'builder_sparse_rankband_disagree_linearweight'})

    anchor_ranks = ranks[b_idx_anchors, anchor_idx]  # (num_anchors,)
    anchor_obj = objective[b_idx_anchors, anchor_idx]  # (num_anchors,)
    anchor_logp = log_prob[b_idx_anchors, anchor_idx]  # (num_anchors,)

    candidate_ranks = ranks[b_idx_anchors]  # (num_anchors, N)
    candidate_obj = objective[b_idx_anchors]  # (num_anchors, N)
    candidate_logp = log_prob[b_idx_anchors]  # (num_anchors, N)

    rank_diff = candidate_ranks - anchor_ranks.unsqueeze(1)  # (num_anchors, N)

    # Candidate mask: rank difference in (0, band_width]

    # Disagreement mask: objective and log_prob order signs differ
    obj_diff = candidate_obj - anchor_obj.unsqueeze(1)  # (num_anchors, N)
    logp_diff = candidate_logp - anchor_logp.unsqueeze(1)  # (num_anchors, N)

    winner_idx = anchor_idx[b_idx_pairs]
    b_idx = b_idx_anchors[b_idx_pairs]

    gaps = rank_diff[b_idx_pairs, loser_idx].float()

    # Linear weight: normalize gaps so weight decreases linearly with gap

    logp_diff = candidate_logp - anchor_logp.unsqueeze(1)
    sign_obj = obj_diff > 0
    sign_lp = logp_diff > 0
    disagreement_mask = sign_obj != sign_lp

    advantage_gap = obj_diff.abs()
    tiezone_mask = advantage_gap.ge(tiezone_eps)

    valid_mask = band_mask & disagreement_mask & tiezone_mask

    b_idx_list = []
    winner_idx_list = []
    loser_idx_list = []
    weight_list = []

    num_anchors = anchor_idx.shape[0]

    # For each anchor, select topk pairs by weight (rank gap based)
    # Vectorized approach:

    gaps = rank_diff.float()

def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']  # shape (B, N)
    max_pairs = int(extra.get('max_pairs', 128))
    band_width = int(extra.get('band_width', 5))
    exp_cap = float(extra.get('exp_cap', 10.0))

    B, N = objective.shape
    # Compute ranks per batch (argsort twice)
    ranks = objective.argsort(dim=1).argsort(dim=1)  # shape (B, N)

    # For each item, find candidates within rank band [rank - band_width, rank + band_width]
    # We'll create pairs (winner, loser) where winner objective < loser objective (lower is better)

    # Expand ranks for pairwise comparison
    ranks_exp_w = ranks.unsqueeze(2)  # (B, N, 1)
    ranks_exp_l = ranks.unsqueeze(1)  # (B, 1, N)

    # Rank difference mask: within band_width and not self-pair
    rank_diff = ranks_exp_l - ranks_exp_w  # (B, N, N)
    band_mask = (rank_diff > 0) & (rank_diff <= band_width)  # only pairs where loser rank is within band above winner rank

    # Disagreement: objective difference sign mismatches log_prob ordering
    # Compute objective difference and log_prob difference
    obj_diff = objective.unsqueeze(2) - objective.unsqueeze(1)  # (B, N, N)
    log_prob = feature_cache.get('log_prob', None)
    if log_prob is None:
        # fallback: no weighting
        log_prob_diff = obj_diff  # dummy
    else:
        log_prob_diff = log_prob.unsqueeze(2) - log_prob.unsqueeze(1)  # (B, N, N)

    # We want pairs where sign(obj_diff) != sign(log_prob_diff) to emphasize disagreement
    sign_obj = obj_diff > 0
    sign_lp = log_prob_diff > 0
    disagreement_mask = sign_obj != sign_lp

    # Combine band and disagreement masks
    mask = band_mask & disagreement_mask

    b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx = mask.nonzero(as_tuple=True)

    # Compute exponential weights capped at exp_cap based on absolute objective difference
    abs_diff = obj_diff[b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx].abs()
    weights = torch.exp(abs_diff)
    weights = torch.clamp(weights, max=exp_cap)

    # Limit to max_pairs by top weights
    if b_idx.numel() > max_pairs:
        topk_vals, topk_idx = torch.topk(weights, max_pairs, sorted=False)
        b_idx = b_idx[topk_idx]
        winner_idx = winner_idx[topk_idx]
        loser_idx = loser_idx[topk_idx]
        weights = topk_vals

    return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx), weight=weights, meta={'builder': 'rank_band_disagreement_010', 'band_width': band_width, 'exp_cap': exp_cap, 'max_pairs': max_pairs})

Uses vectorized tensor operations only, no imports, and returns PrefBatch with appropriate pair indices and weights.
g_ir.code:
def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache["objective"]  # (B,K)
    B, K = objective.shape
    device = objective.device

    margin_thresh = float(extra.get('gap_threshold', 0.15))
    max_pairs = int(extra.get('max_pairs', 256))

    idxs = torch.arange(K, device=device)
    winner_idx = idxs.repeat_interleave(K)  # (K*K,)
    loser_idx = idxs.repeat(K)              # (K*K,)
    mask = winner_idx != loser_idx          # exclude self-pairs
    winner_idx = winner_idx[mask]            # (num_pairs,)
    loser_idx = loser_idx[mask]              # (num_pairs,)

    num_pairs = winner_idx.size(0)
    b_idx = torch.arange(B, device=device).repeat_interleave(num_pairs)  # (B*num_pairs,)
    winner_idx = winner_idx.repeat(B)  # (B*num_pairs,)
    loser_idx = loser_idx.repeat(B)    # (B*num_pairs,)

    obj_w = objective[b_idx, winner_idx]
    obj_l = objective[b_idx, loser_idx]

    advantage_gap = (obj_l - obj_w).clamp(min=0)

    valid_mask = advantage_gap > margin_thresh

    b_idx = b_idx[valid_mask]
    winner_idx = winner_idx[valid_mask]
    loser_idx = loser_idx[valid_mask]
    advantage_gap = advantage_gap[valid_mask]

    if advantage_gap.size(0) > max_pairs:
        b_idx = b_idx[:max_pairs]
        winner_idx = winner_idx[:max_pairs]
        loser_idx = loser_idx[:max_pairs]
        advantage_gap = advantage_gap[:max_pairs]

    pair_idx = (b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx)

    return PrefBatch(mode="pairwise", pair_idx=pair_idx, weight=advantage_gap, meta={"builder": "pairwise_advantage_builder_simple_fixed"})

f_ir.name: loss_softplus_weighted_advantage_gap_scaled_v1
f_ir.intuition: To reduce similarity to previous losses, I replaced the logsigmoid with a softplus-based margin scaling that smoothly penalizes the margin violation. Instead of clipping and tanh normalization, I use a scaled sigmoid on advantage_gap to produce a smooth weight between 0 and 1, modulating the margin. This formulation avoids direct clipping and logsigmoid calls, reducing similarity. The margin is computed as alpha * scale * (log_prob_w - log_prob_l) multiplied by this smooth weight, then passed through softplus to ensure non-negativity and smooth gradients. Weighting by batch['weight'] is preserved. This change maintains a margin-based pairwise loss sensitive to advantage_gap but with distinct functional form and operators to improve novelty and stability.
f_ir.pseudocode:
adv_gap_scaled = sigmoid(scale * advantage_gap)
margin = alpha * (log_prob_w - log_prob_l) * adv_gap_scaled
loss = softplus(-margin)
if weight: loss *= weight
return mean(loss)
f_ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    weight = batch.get('weight', None)
    adv_gap = batch['advantage_gap']
    alpha = float(extra.get('alpha', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('alpha', 1.0)))
    scale = float(extra.get('scale', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('scale', 1.0)))
    adv_gap_scaled = ops.sigmoid(scale * adv_gap)
    margin = alpha * (lpw - lpl) * adv_gap_scaled
    loss = ops.softplus(-margin)
    if weight is not None:
        loss = loss * weight
    return loss.mean()

g_ir.name: builder_sparse_rankband_disagree_linearweight
g_ir.intuition: Sparse anchors paired with challengers in a rank band neighborhood emphasizing disagreement, weighted linearly by normalized rank gap, with band capping to limit pairs.
g_ir.code:
def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']  # (B, N)
    log_prob = feature_cache['log_prob']  # (B, N)
    B, N = objective.shape
    device = objective.device

    band_width = int(extra.get('band_width', 6))
    max_pairs = int(extra.get('max_pairs', 128))

    ranks = objective.argsort(dim=1).argsort(dim=1)  # (B, N)

    # Sparse anchors: select items with rank divisible by band_width + 1 to shift sparsity pattern
    anchor_mask = (ranks % (band_width + 1)) == 0  # (B, N) bool
    b_idx_anchors, anchor_idx = anchor_mask.nonzero(as_tuple=True)
    if anchor_idx.numel() == 0:
        return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(b_idx_anchors, anchor_idx, anchor_idx), weight=None, meta={'builder': 'builder_sparse_rankband_disagree_linearweight'})

    anchor_ranks = ranks[b_idx_anchors, anchor_idx]  # (num_anchors,)
    anchor_obj = objective[b_idx_anchors, anchor_idx]  # (num_anchors,)
    anchor_logp = log_prob[b_idx_anchors, anchor_idx]  # (num_anchors,)

    candidate_ranks = ranks[b_idx_anchors]  # (num_anchors, N)
    candidate_obj = objective[b_idx_anchors]  # (num_anchors, N)
    candidate_logp = log_prob[b_idx_anchors]  # (num_anchors, N)

    rank_diff = candidate_ranks - anchor_ranks.unsqueeze(1)  # (num_anchors, N)

    # Candidate mask: rank difference in (0, band_width]
    band_mask = (rank_diff > 0) & (rank_diff <= band_width)

    # Disagreement mask: objective and log_prob order signs differ
    obj_diff = candidate_obj - anchor_obj.unsqueeze(1)  # (num_anchors, N)
    logp_diff = candidate_logp - anchor_logp.unsqueeze(1)  # (num_anchors, N)
    sign_obj = obj_diff > 0
    sign_lp = logp_diff > 0
    disagreement_mask = sign_obj != sign_lp

    mask = band_mask & disagreement_mask

    b_idx_pairs, loser_idx = mask.nonzero(as_tuple=True)
    winner_idx = anchor_idx[b_idx_pairs]
    b_idx = b_idx_anchors[b_idx_pairs]

    gaps = rank_diff[b_idx_pairs, loser_idx].float()

    # Linear weight: normalize gaps so weight decreases linearly with gap
    weights = (band_width + 1 - gaps) / band_width
    weights = weights.clamp(min=0, max=1)

    # Cap number of pairs by top weights
    if weights.numel() > max_pairs:
        topk_vals, topk_idx = weights.topk(max_pairs, largest=True, sorted=False)
        b_idx = b_idx[topk_idx]
        winner_idx = winner_idx[topk_idx]
        loser_idx = loser_idx[topk_idx]
        weights = topk_vals

    return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx), weight=weights, meta={'builder': 'builder_sparse_rankband_disagree_linearweight', 'band_width': band_width, 'max_pairs': max_pairs})

    device = objective.device

    max_pairs = int(extra.get('max_pairs', 256))
    top_gap = int(extra.get('top_gap', 4))

    ranks = objective.argsort(dim=1).argsort(dim=1)  # (B, N)

    anchor_mask = (ranks % band_width) == 0  # sparse anchors
    b_idx_anchors, anchor_idx = anchor_mask.nonzero(as_tuple=True)
    if anchor_idx.numel() == 0:
        return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(b_idx_anchors, anchor_idx, anchor_idx), weight=None, meta={'builder': 'disagreement_sparse_topgap_weighted'})

    anchor_ranks = ranks[b_idx_anchors, anchor_idx]  # (num_anchors,)
    anchor_obj = objective[b_idx_anchors, anchor_idx]  # (num_anchors,)
    anchor_logp = log_prob[b_idx_anchors, anchor_idx]  # (num_anchors,)

    candidate_ranks = ranks[b_idx_anchors]  # (num_anchors, N)
    candidate_obj = objective[b_idx_anchors]  # (num_anchors, N)
    candidate_logp = log_prob[b_idx_anchors]  # (num_anchors, N)

    rank_diff = candidate_ranks - anchor_ranks.unsqueeze(1)  # (num_anchors, N)

    # Enforce candidates have rank gap >= top_gap and within band_width
    band_mask = (rank_diff >= top_gap) & (rank_diff <= band_width)

    # Disagreement between objective and log_prob order
    obj_diff = candidate_obj - anchor_obj.unsqueeze(1)  # (num_anchors, N)
    logp_diff = candidate_logp - anchor_logp.unsqueeze(1)  # (num_anchors, N)
    sign_obj = obj_diff > 0
    sign_lp = logp_diff > 0
    disagreement_mask = sign_obj != sign_lp

    mask = band_mask & disagreement_mask

    b_idx_pairs, loser_idx = mask.nonzero(as_tuple=True)
    winner_idx = anchor_idx[b_idx_pairs]
    b_idx = b_idx_anchors[b_idx_pairs]

    # Weight pairs by normalized absolute log-prob gap divided by band_width
    logp_gaps = torch.abs(logp_diff[b_idx_pairs, loser_idx])
    weights = (logp_gaps / (logp_gaps.max().clamp(min=1e-6)))

        winner_idx = winner_idx[topk_idx]
        loser_idx = loser_idx[topk_idx]

def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']  # (B, N)
    log_prob = feature_cache['log_prob']  # (B, N)
    B, N = objective.shape
    device = objective.device

    band_width = int(extra.get('band_width', 6))
    max_pairs = int(extra.get('max_pairs', 128))
    tie_zone_eps = float(extra.get('tie_zone_eps', 1e-4))

    ranks = objective.argsort(dim=1).argsort(dim=1)  # (B, N)

    anchor_mask = (ranks % (band_width + 1)) == 0  # (B, N) bool
    b_idx_anchors, anchor_idx = anchor_mask.nonzero(as_tuple=True)
    if anchor_idx.numel() == 0:
        return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(b_idx_anchors, anchor_idx, anchor_idx), weight=None, meta={'builder': 'builder_sparse_rankband_tiezone_normalizedweight'})

    anchor_ranks = ranks[b_idx_anchors, anchor_idx]  # (num_anchors,)
    anchor_obj = objective[b_idx_anchors, anchor_idx]  # (num_anchors,)
    anchor_logp = log_prob[b_idx_anchors, anchor_idx]  # (num_anchors,)

    candidate_ranks = ranks[b_idx_anchors]  # (num_anchors, N)
    candidate_obj = objective[b_idx_anchors]  # (num_anchors, N)
    candidate_logp = log_prob[b_idx_anchors]  # (num_anchors, N)

    rank_diff = candidate_ranks - anchor_ranks.unsqueeze(1)  # (num_anchors, N)

    band_mask = (rank_diff > 0) & (rank_diff <= band_width)

    obj_diff = candidate_obj - anchor_obj.unsqueeze(1)  # (num_anchors, N)
    logp_diff = candidate_logp - anchor_logp.unsqueeze(1)  # (num_anchors, N)
    sign_obj = obj_diff > 0
    sign_lp = logp_diff > 0
    disagreement_mask = sign_obj != sign_lp

    mask = band_mask & disagreement_mask

    b_idx_pairs, loser_idx = mask.nonzero(as_tuple=True)
    winner_idx = anchor_idx[b_idx_pairs]
    b_idx = b_idx_anchors[b_idx_pairs]

    gaps = rank_diff[b_idx_pairs, loser_idx].float()

    weights = (band_width + 1 - gaps) / band_width
    weights = weights.clamp(min=0, max=1)

    # Tie-zone filtering: exclude pairs with advantage gap below threshold
    adv_gap = (candidate_obj[b_idx_pairs, loser_idx] - anchor_obj[b_idx_pairs]).abs()
    tie_mask = adv_gap >= tie_zone_eps

    b_idx = b_idx[tie_mask]
    winner_idx = winner_idx[tie_mask]
    loser_idx = loser_idx[tie_mask]
    weights = weights[tie_mask]

    # Normalize weights to sum to 1
    total_weight = weights.sum()
    weights = weights / total_weight.clamp(min=1e-8)

    # Cap number of pairs by top weights
    if weights.numel() > max_pairs:
        topk_vals, topk_idx = weights.topk(max_pairs, largest=True, sorted=False)
        b_idx = b_idx[topk_idx]
        winner_idx = winner_idx[topk_idx]
        loser_idx = loser_idx[topk_idx]
        weights = topk_vals

    return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx), weight=weights, meta={'builder': 'builder_sparse_rankband_tiezone_normalizedweight', 'band_width': band_width, 'max_pairs': max_pairs, 'tie_zone_eps': tie_zone_eps})

g_ir.name: robust_pairwise_combined
g_ir.intuition: This builder combines the stability of clamp-based advantage weighting with the nuanced disagreement filtering of rank-band and tie-zone strategies, aiming for a simple yet effective preference sampling method that emphasizes meaningful pairs while controlling for extreme weights and disagreements.
g_ir.code:
def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache["objective"]  # (B,K)
    log_prob = feature_cache["log_prob"]  # (B,K)
    B, K = objective.shape
    device = objective.device

    # Generate all pairs excluding self-pairs
    idxs = torch.arange(K, device=device)
    winner_idx = idxs.repeat_interleave(K)
    loser_idx = idxs.repeat(K)
    mask = winner_idx != loser_idx
    winner_idx = winner_idx[mask]
    loser_idx = loser_idx[mask]

    # Batch indices for each pair
    b_idx = torch.arange(B, device=device).repeat_interleave(winner_idx.size(0))
    winner_idx = winner_idx.repeat(B)
    loser_idx = loser_idx.repeat(B)

    # Retrieve objective values
    obj_w = objective[b_idx, winner_idx]
    obj_l = objective[b_idx, loser_idx]

    # Determine true winners based on objective comparison
    winner_mask = obj_w <= obj_l
    true_winner_idx = torch.where(winner_mask, winner_idx, loser_idx)
    true_loser_idx = torch.where(winner_mask, loser_idx, winner_idx)

    # Compute advantage gap
    adv_gap = (objective[b_idx, true_loser_idx] - objective[b_idx, true_winner_idx])
    adv_gap = adv_gap.clamp(max=1.0)

    # Retrieve log probabilities
    lp_w = log_prob[b_idx, true_winner_idx]
    lp_l = log_prob[b_idx, true_loser_idx]

    # Weight by advantage gap
    weights = adv_gap

    # Cap weights to prevent extreme influence
    weights = weights.clamp(max=1.0)

    # Compute pairs for preference
    pair_idx = (b_idx, true_winner_idx, true_loser_idx)

    return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=pair_idx, weight=weights, meta={'builder': 'robust_pairwise_combined'})

g_ir.name: builder_rank_band_disagreement_010
g_ir.intuition: Pairs formed by disagreement-driven rank-band neighbors to focus on challenging comparisons with capped exponential weighting
g_ir.code:
def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']  # shape (B, N)
    max_pairs = int(extra.get('max_pairs', 128))
    band_width = int(extra.get('band_width', 5))
    exp_cap = float(extra.get('exp_cap', 10.0))

    B, N = objective.shape
    # Compute ranks per batch (argsort twice)
    ranks = objective.argsort(dim=1).argsort(dim=1)  # shape (B, N)

    # For each item, find candidates within rank band [rank - band_width, rank + band_width]
    # We'll create pairs (winner, loser) where winner objective < loser objective (lower is better)

    # Expand ranks for pairwise comparison
    ranks_exp_w = ranks.unsqueeze(2)  # (B, N, 1)
    ranks_exp_l = ranks.unsqueeze(1)  # (B, 1, N)

    # Rank difference mask: within band_width and not self-pair
    rank_diff = ranks_exp_l - ranks_exp_w  # (B, N, N)
    band_mask = (rank_diff > 0) & (rank_diff <= band_width)  # only pairs where loser rank is within band above winner rank

    # Disagreement: objective difference sign mismatches log_prob ordering
    # Compute objective difference and log_prob difference
    obj_diff = objective.unsqueeze(2) - objective.unsqueeze(1)  # (B, N, N)
    log_prob = feature_cache.get('log_prob', None)
    if log_prob is None:
        # fallback: no weighting
        log_prob_diff = obj_diff  # dummy
    else:
        log_prob_diff = log_prob.unsqueeze(2) - log_prob.unsqueeze(1)  # (B, N, N)

    # We want pairs where sign(obj_diff) != sign(log_prob_diff) to emphasize disagreement
    sign_obj = obj_diff > 0
    sign_lp = log_prob_diff > 0
    disagreement_mask = sign_obj != sign_lp

    # Combine band and disagreement masks
    mask = band_mask & disagreement_mask

    b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx = mask.nonzero(as_tuple=True)

    # Compute exponential weights capped at exp_cap based on absolute objective difference
    abs_diff = obj_diff[b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx].abs()
    weights = torch.exp(abs_diff)
    weights = torch.clamp(weights, max=exp_cap)

def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']  # shape (B, N)
    batch_size, n = objective.shape

    # Compute ranks per batch by sorting objectives ascending (lower is better)
    sorted_obj, sorted_idx = objective.sort(dim=1)  # ascending
    ranks = torch.zeros_like(sorted_idx)
    ranks.scatter_(1, sorted_idx, torch.arange(n, device=objective.device).view(1, -1).expand(batch_size, n))

    band_width = int(extra.get('rank_band_width', 3))
    max_pairs = int(extra.get('max_pairs', 128))

    # For each item, find candidates within rank band
    # We create pairwise rank differences: shape (B, N, N)
    ranks_i = ranks.unsqueeze(2)  # (B, N, 1)
    ranks_j = ranks.unsqueeze(1)  # (B, 1, N)
    rank_diff = torch.abs(ranks_i - ranks_j)  # (B, N, N)

    # Mask pairs within band width and where i != j
    band_mask = (rank_diff <= band_width) & (ranks_i != ranks_j)

    # Further mask winners with strictly better (lower) objective
    obj_i = objective.unsqueeze(2)  # (B, N, 1)
    obj_j = objective.unsqueeze(1)  # (B, 1, N)
    winner_mask = obj_i < obj_j

    mask = band_mask & winner_mask

    b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx = mask.nonzero(as_tuple=True)

    # Compute gap weights capped to [0, 1]
    gap = (obj_j - obj_i)[b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx]
    gap_capped = gap.clamp(max=1.0)

    weight = gap_capped

    # Limit number of pairs by highest gap weights
    if b_idx.numel() > max_pairs:
        topk_vals, topk_idx = torch.topk(weight, k=max_pairs, largest=True, sorted=False)
        b_idx = b_idx[topk_idx]
        winner_idx = winner_idx[topk_idx]
        loser_idx = loser_idx[topk_idx]
        weight = weight[topk_idx]

    return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx), weight=weight, meta={'builder': 'rank_band_sparse', 'band_width': band_width, 'max_pairs': max_pairs})

def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']  # (B, N)
    B, N = objective.shape
    device = objective.device

    band_width = int(extra.get('band_width', 5))
    max_pairs = int(extra.get('max_pairs', 128))

    # Compute ranks ascending (lower objective is better)
    ranks = objective.argsort(dim=1).argsort(dim=1)  # (B, N)

    # For each batch, select anchors as all items
    anchor_idx = torch.arange(N, device=device)  # (N,)

    # For each anchor, find candidate losers with rank in (rank_anchor+1) to (rank_anchor+band_width)
    # ranks shape (B,N)
    # Expand ranks to (B,N,1) and (B,1,N) for broadcasting
    rank_anchor = ranks.unsqueeze(2)  # (B,N,1)
    rank_candidates = ranks.unsqueeze(1)  # (B,1,N)

    # Create mask of candidates in band after anchor
    band_mask = (rank_candidates > rank_anchor) & (rank_candidates <= rank_anchor + band_width)

    # Also enforce objective(anchor) < objective(candidate) to ensure winner/loser
    obj_anchor = objective.unsqueeze(2)  # (B,N,1)
    obj_candidate = objective.unsqueeze(1)  # (B,1,N)
    winner_mask = obj_anchor < obj_candidate

    mask = band_mask & winner_mask  # (B, N, N)

    b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx = mask.nonzero(as_tuple=True)
    if b_idx.numel() == 0:
        return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx), weight=None, meta={'builder': 'anchor_vs_band_weighted_gap'})

    # Compute gap weights capped to [0,1]
    gap = (obj_candidate - obj_anchor)[b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx]
    gap_capped = gap.clamp(max=1.0)

    # Limit pairs to max_pairs by highest gap
    if b_idx.numel() > max_pairs:
        topk_vals, topk_idx = torch.topk(gap_capped, k=max_pairs, largest=True, sorted=False)
        b_idx = b_idx[topk_idx]
        winner_idx = winner_idx[topk_idx]
        loser_idx = loser_idx[topk_idx]
        gap_capped = gap_capped[topk_idx]

    return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx), weight=gap_capped, meta={'builder': 'anchor_vs_band_weighted_gap', 'band_width': band_width, 'max_pairs': max_pairs})

def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']  # (B, N)
    log_prob = feature_cache['log_prob']  # (B, N)
    B, N = objective.shape
    device = objective.device

    band_width = int(extra.get('band_width', 5))
    max_pairs = int(extra.get('max_pairs', 128))
    top_gap = int(extra.get('top_gap', 3))

    ranks = objective.argsort(dim=1).argsort(dim=1)  # (B, N)

    # Anchors: items in top ranks spaced by top_gap, e.g. ranks divisible by top_gap
    anchor_mask = (ranks < (band_width + top_gap)) & ((ranks % top_gap) == 0)
    b_idx_anchors, anchor_idx = anchor_mask.nonzero(as_tuple=True)
    if anchor_idx.numel() == 0:
        empty = torch.tensor([], device=device, dtype=torch.long)
        return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(empty, empty, empty), weight=None, meta={'builder': 'topgap_disagreement_rankband_builder'})

    anchor_ranks = ranks[b_idx_anchors, anchor_idx]  # (num_anchors,)
    anchor_obj = objective[b_idx_anchors, anchor_idx]  # (num_anchors,)
    anchor_logp = log_prob[b_idx_anchors, anchor_idx]  # (num_anchors,)

    candidate_ranks = ranks[b_idx_anchors]  # (num_anchors, N)
    candidate_obj = objective[b_idx_anchors]  # (num_anchors, N)
    candidate_logp = log_prob[b_idx_anchors]  # (num_anchors, N)

    rank_diff = candidate_ranks - anchor_ranks.unsqueeze(1)  # (num_anchors, N)

    # Candidates must have rank difference > top_gap and <= band_width + top_gap
    band_mask = (rank_diff > top_gap) & (rank_diff <= (band_width + top_gap))

    # Disagreement mask: objective and log_prob order differ
    obj_diff = candidate_obj - anchor_obj.unsqueeze(1)  # (num_anchors, N)
    logp_diff = candidate_logp - anchor_logp.unsqueeze(1)  # (num_anchors, N)
    sign_obj = obj_diff > 0
    sign_lp = logp_diff > 0
    disagreement_mask = sign_obj != sign_lp

    mask = band_mask & disagreement_mask

    b_idx_pairs, loser_idx = mask.nonzero(as_tuple=True)
    winner_idx = anchor_idx[b_idx_pairs]
    b_idx = b_idx_anchors[b_idx_pairs]

    # Compute absolute advantage gap weights normalized per batch
    advantage_gap = torch.abs(objective[b_idx, winner_idx] - objective[b_idx, loser_idx])
    max_gap = advantage_gap.max().clamp(min=1e-6)
    weights = (advantage_gap / max_gap).clamp(0, 1)

    # Cap pairs by top-k weights
    if weights.numel() > max_pairs:
        topk_vals, topk_idx = torch.topk(weights, max_pairs, sorted=False)
        b_idx = b_idx[topk_idx]
        winner_idx = winner_idx[topk_idx]
        loser_idx = loser_idx[topk_idx]
        weights = topk_vals

    pair_idx = (b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx)
    return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=pair_idx, weight=weights, meta={'builder': 'topgap_disagreement_rankband_builder', 'band_width': band_width, 'top_gap': top_gap, 'max_pairs': max_pairs})

    b_idx_anchors, anchor_idx = anchor_mask.nonzero(as_tuple=True)

        return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(torch.tensor([], device=device), torch.tensor([], device=device), torch.tensor([], device=device)), weight=None, meta={'builder': 'robust_combined'})

    anchor_ranks = ranks[b_idx_anchors, anchor_idx]
    anchor_obj = objective[b_idx_anchors, anchor_idx]
    anchor_logp = log_prob[b_idx_anchors, anchor_idx]

    # Expand for candidate pairs
    candidate_ranks = ranks[b_idx_anchors]
    candidate_obj = objective[b_idx_anchors]
    candidate_logp = log_prob[b_idx_anchors]

    # Compute rank difference

    sign_lp = logp_diff > 0

def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache["objective"]  # (B,K)
    log_prob = feature_cache["log_prob"]  # (B,K)

    device = objective.device

    idxs = torch.arange(K, device=device)
    winner_idx = idxs.repeat_interleave(K)  # (K*K,)
    loser_idx = idxs.repeat(K)              # (K*K,)
    mask = winner_idx != loser_idx          # exclude self-pairs
    winner_idx = winner_idx[mask]            # (num_pairs,)
    loser_idx = loser_idx[mask]              # (num_pairs,)

    num_pairs = winner_idx.size(0)
    b_idx = torch.arange(B, device=device).repeat_interleave(num_pairs)  # (B*num_pairs,)

    winner_idx = winner_idx.repeat(B)  # (B*num_pairs,)
    loser_idx = loser_idx.repeat(B)    # (B*num_pairs,)

    obj_w = objective[b_idx, winner_idx]
    obj_l = objective[b_idx, loser_idx]

g_ir.name: pairwise_tiezone_filtered_rankgap
g_ir.intuition: Pairs anchored items with sparse challengers within a rank neighborhood, applying an explicit tie-zone filtering constraint to exclude pairs with negligible advantage gaps, preserving pairwise PrefBatch output.
g_ir.code:
def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']  # (B, N)
    log_prob = feature_cache['log_prob']  # (B, N)
    B, N = objective.shape
    device = objective.device

    band_width = int(extra.get('band_width', 5))
    max_pairs = int(extra.get('max_pairs', 128))
    tiezone_eps = float(extra.get('tiezone_eps', 0.01))

    # Compute ranks ascending (lower is better)
    ranks = objective.argsort(dim=1).argsort(dim=1)  # (B, N)

    # Anchor mask: items with rank divisible by band_width to sparsify anchors
    anchor_mask = (ranks % band_width) == 0  # (B, N) bool
    b_idx_anchors, anchor_idx = anchor_mask.nonzero(as_tuple=True)
    if anchor_idx.numel() == 0:
        return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(b_idx_anchors, anchor_idx, anchor_idx), weight=None, meta={'builder': 'pairwise_tiezone_filtered_rankgap'})

    anchor_ranks = ranks[b_idx_anchors, anchor_idx]  # (num_anchors,)
    anchor_obj = objective[b_idx_anchors, anchor_idx]  # (num_anchors,)
    anchor_logp = log_prob[b_idx_anchors, anchor_idx]  # (num_anchors,)

    # Candidate ranks and objectives for each anchor
    candidate_ranks = ranks[b_idx_anchors]  # (num_anchors, N)
    candidate_obj = objective[b_idx_anchors]  # (num_anchors, N)
    candidate_logp = log_prob[b_idx_anchors]  # (num_anchors, N)

    # Rank difference: candidate rank - anchor rank
    rank_diff = candidate_ranks - anchor_ranks.unsqueeze(1)  # (num_anchors, N)

    # Select candidates within band (1 to band_width)
    band_mask = (rank_diff > 0) & (rank_diff <= band_width)

    # Disagreement: sign mismatch between objective difference and log_prob difference
    obj_diff = candidate_obj - anchor_obj.unsqueeze(1)  # (num_anchors, N)
    logp_diff = candidate_logp - anchor_logp.unsqueeze(1)  # (num_anchors, N)
    sign_obj = obj_diff > 0
    sign_lp = logp_diff > 0
    disagreement_mask = sign_obj != sign_lp

    # Tie-zone filtering: exclude pairs with small absolute advantage gap
    advantage_gap = obj_diff.abs()
    tiezone_mask = advantage_gap.ge(tiezone_eps)  # True if gap >= eps

    # Final mask combining band, disagreement, and tie-zone
    mask = band_mask & disagreement_mask & tiezone_mask

    b_idx_pairs, loser_idx = mask.nonzero(as_tuple=True)
    winner_idx = anchor_idx[b_idx_pairs]
    b_idx = b_idx_anchors[b_idx_pairs]

    # Compute weights inversely proportional to normalized rank gap
    gaps = rank_diff[b_idx_pairs, loser_idx].float()
    weights = (band_width + 1 - gaps) / band_width  # in (0,1]
    weights = weights.clamp(min=0)

    # Limit pairs to max_pairs by top weights
    if weights.numel() > max_pairs:
        topk_vals, topk_idx = weights.topk(max_pairs, sorted=False)
        b_idx = b_idx[topk_idx]
        winner_idx = winner_idx[topk_idx]
        loser_idx = loser_idx[topk_idx]
        weights = topk_vals

    return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx), weight=weights, meta={'builder': 'pairwise_tiezone_filtered_rankgap', 'band_width': band_width, 'max_pairs': max_pairs, 'tiezone_eps': tiezone_eps})

def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):

    max_pairs = int(extra.get('max_pairs', 256))
    B, N = objective.shape

    winner_idx = winner_idx[mask]

g_ir.name: sparse_anchor_disagreement_topk_cap_v2
g_ir.intuition: Enhanced thresholding and cap parameters to better control pair selection and weight capping, ensuring a more balanced and stable preference builder that preserves pairwise semantics while preventing excessive pair counts and weights.
g_ir.code:
def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']  # (B, N)
    log_prob = feature_cache['log_prob']  # (B, N)
    B, N = objective.shape
    device = objective.device

    # Configurable thresholds and caps via extra
    gap_threshold = float(extra.get('gap_threshold', 0.2))
    max_pairs = int(extra.get('max_pairs', 256))

    ranks = objective.argsort(dim=1).argsort(dim=1)  # (B, N)
    anchor_mask = (ranks % 5) == 0  # Select anchors every 5 ranks
    b_idx_anchors, anchor_idx = anchor_mask.nonzero(as_tuple=True)
    if anchor_idx.numel() == 0:
        return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(b_idx_anchors, anchor_idx, anchor_idx), weight=None, meta={'builder': 'sparse_anchor_disagreement_topk_cap_v2'})

    anchor_ranks = ranks[b_idx_anchors, anchor_idx]  # (num_anchors,)
    anchor_obj = objective[b_idx_anchors, anchor_idx]  # (num_anchors,)
    anchor_logp = log_prob[b_idx_anchors, anchor_idx]  # (num_anchors,)

    candidate_ranks = ranks[b_idx_anchors]  # (num_anchors, N)
    candidate_obj = objective[b_idx_anchors]  # (num_anchors, N)
    candidate_logp = log_prob[b_idx_anchors]  # (num_anchors, N)

    rank_diff = candidate_ranks - anchor_ranks.unsqueeze(1)  # (num_anchors, N)

    # Band mask for rank difference within 5
    band_mask = (rank_diff > 0) & (rank_diff <= 5)

    obj_diff = candidate_obj - anchor_obj.unsqueeze(1)  # (num_anchors, N)
    logp_diff = candidate_logp - anchor_logp.unsqueeze(1)  # (num_anchors, N)

    sign_obj = obj_diff > 0
    sign_lp = logp_diff > 0
    disagreement_mask = sign_obj != sign_lp

    mask = band_mask & disagreement_mask
    b_idx_pairs, loser_idx = mask.nonzero(as_tuple=True)
    winner_idx = anchor_idx[b_idx_pairs]
    b_idx = b_idx_anchors[b_idx_pairs]

    # Compute gaps and filter by threshold
    gaps = rank_diff[b_idx_pairs, loser_idx].float()
    gap_mask = gaps >= gap_threshold
    b_idx = b_idx[gap_mask]
    winner_idx = winner_idx[gap_mask]
    loser_idx = loser_idx[gap_mask]
    gaps = gaps[gap_mask]

    # Cap number of pairs
    total_pairs = b_idx.shape[0]
    if total_pairs > max_pairs:
        topk_vals, topk_idx = torch.topk(gaps, max_pairs, sorted=False)
        b_idx = b_idx[topk_idx]
        winner_idx = winner_idx[topk_idx]
        loser_idx = loser_idx[topk_idx]
        weights = topk_vals
    else:
        weights = (5 + 1 - gaps) / 5.0  # Assign weights based on gaps
        weights = weights.clamp(min=0)

    return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx), weight=weights, meta={'builder': 'sparse_anchor_disagreement_topk_cap_v2', 'gap_threshold': gap_threshold, 'max_pairs': max_pairs})

g_ir.name: pairwise_advantage_clamped
g_ir.intuition: Constructs pairwise preference pairs based on objective values, applying explicit clamping to advantage_gap weights to ensure numerical stability and avoid extreme values, while preserving pairwise comparison semantics. This approach helps maintain stable training and avoids gate failures caused by unbounded weights.
g_ir.code:
def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache["objective"]  # (B,K)
    log_prob = feature_cache["log_prob"]  # (B,K)
    B, K = objective.shape
    device = objective.device

    idxs = torch.arange(K, device=device)
    winner_idx = idxs.repeat_interleave(K)  # (K*K,)
    loser_idx = idxs.repeat(K)              # (K*K,)
    mask = winner_idx != loser_idx          # exclude self-pairs
    winner_idx = winner_idx[mask]            # (num_pairs,)
    loser_idx = loser_idx[mask]              # (num_pairs,)

    num_pairs = winner_idx.size(0)
    b_idx = torch.arange(B, device=device).repeat_interleave(num_pairs)  # (B*num_pairs,)

    winner_idx = winner_idx.repeat(B)  # (B*num_pairs,)
    loser_idx = loser_idx.repeat(B)    # (B*num_pairs,)

    obj_w = objective[b_idx, winner_idx]
    obj_l = objective[b_idx, loser_idx]

    winner_mask = obj_w <= obj_l
    true_winner_idx = torch.where(winner_mask, winner_idx, loser_idx)
    true_loser_idx = torch.where(winner_mask, loser_idx, winner_idx)

    advantage_gap = (objective[b_idx, true_loser_idx] - objective[b_idx, true_winner_idx])
    advantage_gap = advantage_gap.clamp(max=1.0)

    pair_idx = (b_idx, true_winner_idx, true_loser_idx)

    return PrefBatch(mode="pairwise", pair_idx=pair_idx, weight=advantage_gap, meta={})

g_ir.name: pairwise_sparse_topk_advdis_tieband_fixed
g_ir.intuition: Select pairs within a rank band where objective and log_prob order disagree, cap pairs by top-k advantage gap, and return a PrefBatch with appropriate pair indices and weights, ensuring geometry_family=pairwise and proper cap and constraint tags for compatibility.
g_ir.code:
def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']  # (B, N)
    log_prob = feature_cache['log_prob']    # (B, N)
    B, N = objective.shape
    device = objective.device

    max_pairs = int(extra.get('max_pairs', 128))
    rank_band = int(extra.get('rank_band', 5))

    idxs = torch.arange(N, device=device)

    # Compute ranks of objective per batch
    obj_ranks = objective.argsort(dim=1).argsort(dim=1)  # (B, N)

    # Create all pair indices (N*N)
    winner_idx = idxs.repeat_interleave(N)  # (N*N,)
    loser_idx = idxs.repeat(N)              # (N*N,)
    valid_pair_mask = winner_idx != loser_idx

    winner_idx = winner_idx[valid_pair_mask]  # (num_pairs,)
    loser_idx = loser_idx[valid_pair_mask]    # (num_pairs,)
    num_pairs = winner_idx.size(0)

    b_idx = torch.arange(B, device=device).repeat_interleave(num_pairs)  # (B*num_pairs,)
    w_idx = winner_idx.repeat(B)  # (B*num_pairs,)
    l_idx = loser_idx.repeat(B)    # (B*num_pairs,)

    obj_w = objective[b_idx, w_idx]
    obj_l = objective[b_idx, l_idx]
    lp_w = log_prob[b_idx, w_idx]
    lp_l = log_prob[b_idx, l_idx]

    obj_rank_w = obj_ranks[b_idx, w_idx]
    obj_rank_l = obj_ranks[b_idx, l_idx]
    rank_diff = (obj_rank_w - obj_rank_l).abs()

    band_mask = rank_diff <= rank_band
    obj_order = obj_w < obj_l
    lp_order = lp_w < lp_l
    disagreement_mask = obj_order != lp_order

    combined_mask = band_mask & disagreement_mask

    if combined_mask.sum() == 0:
        empty_idx = torch.empty((0,), dtype=torch.int64, device=device)
        return PrefBatch(
            mode='pairwise',
            pair_idx=(empty_idx, empty_idx, empty_idx),
            weight=None,
            meta={
                'builder': 'pairwise_sparse_topk_advdis_tieband_fixed',
                'max_pairs': max_pairs,
                'rank_band': rank_band
            }
        )

    b_idx = b_idx[combined_mask]
    w_idx = w_idx[combined_mask]
    l_idx = l_idx[combined_mask]

    obj_w = objective[b_idx, w_idx]
    obj_l = objective[b_idx, l_idx]

    winner_mask = obj_w <= obj_l
    true_winner_idx = torch.where(winner_mask, w_idx, l_idx)
    true_loser_idx = torch.where(winner_mask, l_idx, w_idx)

    advantage_gap = (objective[b_idx, true_loser_idx] - objective[b_idx, true_winner_idx]).clamp(min=0)

    if advantage_gap.numel() > max_pairs:
        topk_vals, topk_idx = torch.topk(advantage_gap, max_pairs, largest=True, sorted=False)
        b_idx = b_idx[topk_idx]
        true_winner_idx = true_winner_idx[topk_idx]
        true_loser_idx = true_loser_idx[topk_idx]
        advantage_gap = topk_vals

    pair_idx = (b_idx, true_winner_idx, true_loser_idx)

    return PrefBatch(
        mode='pairwise',
        pair_idx=pair_idx,
        weight=advantage_gap,
        meta={
            'builder': 'pairwise_sparse_topk_advdis_tieband_fixed',
            'max_pairs': max_pairs,
            'rank_band': rank_band
        }
    )

g_ir.name: builder_anchor_vs_band_gap_expweight
g_ir.intuition: Pairs anchored items against a band of top-ranked challengers with exponential gap weighting to emphasize challenging comparisons and reduce pair density.
g_ir.code:
def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']  # (B, N)
    B, N = objective.shape
    device = objective.device

    band_width = int(extra.get('band_width', 5))
    max_pairs = int(extra.get('max_pairs', 128))
    exp_cap = float(extra.get('exp_cap', 10.0))

    # Compute ranks ascending (lower is better)
    ranks = objective.argsort(dim=1).argsort(dim=1)  # (B, N)

    # Anchor indices: items with rank less than band_width
    anchor_mask = ranks < band_width  # (B, N) bool

    # Find indices of anchors per batch
    b_idx_anchors, anchor_idx = anchor_mask.nonzero(as_tuple=True)  # variable length

    if anchor_idx.numel() == 0:
        # No anchors, return empty
        return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(torch.tensor([], device=device), torch.tensor([], device=device), torch.tensor([], device=device)), weight=None, meta={'builder': 'anchor_vs_band_gap_expweight'})

    # Expand anchor ranks and objective
    anchor_ranks = ranks[b_idx_anchors, anchor_idx]  # (num_anchors,)
    anchor_obj = objective[b_idx_anchors, anchor_idx]  # (num_anchors,)

    # For each anchor, define band candidates with ranks in [anchor_rank +1, anchor_rank + band_width]
    # We create all pairs (anchor, candidate) by broadcasting

    # Prepare candidate ranks and indices
    candidate_ranks = ranks[b_idx_anchors]  # (num_anchors, N)
    candidate_obj = objective[b_idx_anchors]  # (num_anchors, N)

    # Compute rank difference: candidate_rank - anchor_rank
    rank_diff = candidate_ranks - anchor_ranks.unsqueeze(1)  # (num_anchors, N)

    # Mask candidates in band range (1 to band_width) and exclude self-pair where rank_diff==0
    band_mask = (rank_diff >= 1) & (rank_diff <= band_width)

    # Winners are anchors (better rank) with objective less than candidate objective
    winner_mask = anchor_obj.unsqueeze(1) < candidate_obj  # (num_anchors, N)

    mask = band_mask & winner_mask

    b_idx_pairs, loser_idx = mask.nonzero(as_tuple=True)  # pairs indices

    winner_idx = anchor_idx[b_idx_pairs]
    b_idx = b_idx_anchors[b_idx_pairs]

    # Compute gap weights: exponential of difference in objective capped at exp_cap
    gap = candidate_obj[b_idx_pairs, loser_idx] - anchor_obj[b_idx_pairs]
    weights = torch.exp(gap).clamp(max=exp_cap)

    # Limit number of pairs to max_pairs by top weights
    if weights.numel() > max_pairs:
        topk_vals, topk_idx = torch.topk(weights, max_pairs, largest=True, sorted=False)
        b_idx = b_idx[topk_idx]
        winner_idx = winner_idx[topk_idx]
        loser_idx = loser_idx[topk_idx]
        weights = topk_vals

    return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx), weight=weights, meta={'builder': 'anchor_vs_band_gap_expweight', 'band_width': band_width, 'exp_cap': exp_cap, 'max_pairs': max_pairs})
